author: National Geographic
description:
What do we know about the sun? In this Mega Episode documentary special from National Geographic, experts from around the globe explore and investigate phenomenons related to Earth's nearest star. Learn about the tiny spacecraft defying the odds to undergo mission impossible to get closer to the sun than ever before. Join NASA scientists to study the surface of the sun, including mysterious dark spots, magnetic tornados, and violent eruptions, to better monitor and understand the effects of solar storms on Earth's surface. Finally, unearth the architectural magic of spots like Cambodia's Angkor Wat temple and India's Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, to dive into ancient civilization's knowledge of astronomy. 

Featuring three, full episodes:

Mission to the Sun - 00:00
